root_motivation: **Who:** the agent asking "which providers can I connect, with which scope names?"; Joe adding a provider; the builder of every later connection PRD. **What:** one place a provider is described, every surface derived from it. **Why not today:** `vault.rs:71-90` knows three presets; `host.vault.provider_set`'s schema has no enum (`handler.rs:3589`); `llms.txt:504` repeats the three names by hand; no surface says which scopes a provider accepts, whether its tokens expire, or whether the host has a client id for it. Creative premise: one TOML table is enough shape for every provider (GitHub tokens never expire, Google needs `access_type=offline`, Slack rotates by opt-in). Falsifier above.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.job.timeline(run_id) and reads which step ran how long, failed with which error class and family, or is still running.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given `providers.toml` with `testprov` added under `test-support`, When the crate builds and the five surfaces are read, Then `host.connect.providers`, the `provider` enum, `docs/connections.md`, `www/llms.txt` and the callback route table all contain `testprov` with no edit outside `providers.toml`.
Given a hand edit that adds `"fakeprov"` to any one of the five surfaces, When `tests/cprov_ac02_provider_surfaces_cannot_drift.rs` runs, Then it fails naming the surface and the extra name.

Given `MCPHOST_CONNECT_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` set and `MCPHOST_CONNECT_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` unset, When `host.connect.providers` runs, Then `github` has `available: false, reason: "client_secret_not_configured"` and the response contains neither env value.
Given `Provider::GOOGLE`, When `validate_scopes(["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.readonly", "bogus"])` runs, Then it returns `Err(["bogus"])`.

scope: src/handler.rs, src/tool_aliases.rs: host.job.timeline and alias host.job_timeline.
src/kinds/mod.rs, src/db.rs: a composed child row exists from step start (in_flight) and for an undispatched mapping-miss step.
non_goals: A web page; timelines across runs; storing anything new; fan-out items and the text format (P1).

additional.token_never_stored: only sha256(token) is stored; the token is shown once by the dry run.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can a client not trust what this host speaks?
five_whys_trace.a: initialize advertises tools only, but rmcp's default hooks answer empty results for resources and prompts.

ambiguities_resolved.question: How does a step that never dispatched or is still running get a row?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Chain writes an error row for a mapping-miss step under on_error continue, and every composed child is inserted as in_flight at start and settled at finish; in_flight is never running/queued so executor counts and leases ignore it.
